schema_validation_cases.name: realm_actor_frontier_old_singular_shape_rejected
schema_validation_cases.first_expected_error: contains:is not valid under any of the given schemas

assertions: delta frontier catchup_complete and dropped carry cursor
heartbeat resync_required and unauthorized never advance reconnect position
catchup_complete is emitted only after a baseline delta when catchup is true
catchup_complete is forbidden when catchup is false
a server without a drop cursor emits resync_required instead of cursorless dropped
the same trace rules apply to account and events streams

expired_cursor_not_reused.description: client-sync.md §12.3.1 — after cursor_expired / cursor_integrity_invalid, the failed cursor MUST be discarded. The client may only rebuild account.subscribe without after (initial sync) or snapshot-bootstrap via snapshot/head; it MUST NOT reuse the failed cursor as any after= / before= start, and a snapshot frontier event_id MUST NOT be placed into after= (frontier is a stop predicate, not a cursor).

forbidden_recovery.reject_reason: param_invalid: snapshot frontier event_id is not a cursor

cases.name: duplicate_signer_counts_once
cases.note: witness_id is not unique across rows, so the manifest fails the list rule before quorum counting; when one witness signs with two keys in one row set the deduplicated count is 1 and quorum fails as well

cases.name: revoked_witness_not_counted
cases.note: witness C was revoked at 2026-04-25T00:00:00.000Z, strictly before snapshot_created_at

cases.name: wrong_context_rejected
cases.note: reusing the manifest context yields a different transcript digest and MUST be rejected even when the JWS verifies

cases.name: projection_must_not_contain_signature_fields
cases.note: a witness that signed the manifest including witness_attestations would sign a transcript containing its own signature

cases.name: witness_list_reordered_invalidates_issuer_signature
cases.note: rows MUST be sorted by witness_id UTF-8 byte order; a receiver rejects the unsorted list and MUST NOT normalize it first
